create_SubtaskSuccessDetectorV4: create a SubtaskSuccessDetectorV4 instance with an event bus, config, and API key
run_detect_success: run detect_success on a subtask string to check if the robot completed it
build_prompt_for_success_detection: build a multimodal prompt with start and latest camera images for success detection
query_success_signal: query the Gemini model via _query_success_signal to evaluate task completion from camera views
set_timeout_seconds: set the timeout in seconds on an AbstractSuccessDetectionTool to limit how long success detection runs
